div.p: A rural and residential suburb on the South Gippsland Highway, between Cranbourne South and Clyde, Devon Meadows is part of the farming belt that includes Pearcedale, Five Ways and Junction Village. It features rural industries such as Eatmore Poultry. Devon Meadows is called after Benjamin Cox's Devon estate, itself named after the English county.
